scope: All named authority rows in the two discovered official fiscal-year statistics files; no additional years searched.
method: All lines with eight trailing numeric cells were parsed from pdftotext -layout; all other nonblank lines were reviewed and are titles or column headings. Category totals and grand totals are kept apart from authority rows. Islands Trust is retained as a named authority, not discarded as an aggregate.
source_interpretation: The table heading expressly describes authorities by section of the Schedule to the Ombudsperson Act. Rows are dated official jurisdiction observations, not a statutory commencement or an adjudication of every possible complaint.
temporal_cautions: The stated fiscal period dates the reported caseload; it does not prove the first or last day of legal coverage.

Do not treat a printed label as proof that the same name existed throughout the stated fiscal year. The 2019/20 table uses some later ministry and professional-college labels; retrospective relabeling or aggregation must be allowed for.
An authority listed in these 2019/20 or 2020/21 tables is not automatically assigned a 2026 coverage edge.
Absence is not evidence of exclusion: the tables report file activity, not a complete census of every authority covered by law.
The upload URL contains 2025/08; this is not the date of the reporting period or a coverage commencement.
Category headings are the report author’s groupings. No exact Schedule subparagraph is silently inferred from a heading.
